# Brandon Davenport

> Tech evangelist who ships: built Hgraph's AI and data tooling, elected member of the Hiero Technical Steering Committee, and creator of the Hashgraph Enthusiasts Show.

Brandon Davenport works both sides of technology and audience: architecting systems with engineers, then presenting on stage, on camera, and on the timeline to build interest and adoption around them.

## Work

- [/work](https://itsbrandond.com/work): a fuller look at what's been built, shipped, and closed, grouped into evangelizing and communicating, building and shipping, and creative (earlier-career design, video, and music work).
- [Hgraph](https://hgraph.com): built the AI and data tooling with the team, including a [Model Context Protocol server and an AI data agent](https://docs.hgraph.com/mcp-server/setup-chatgpt) that answer plain-English questions about Hedera Stats' ecosystem metrics.
- [Hgraph's 2026 platform recap](https://hgraph.com/blog/hgraph-in-2026-the-full-stack-onchain-data-platform): authored piece, the company's mid-2026 recap of what shipped.
- [Hiero Technical Steering Committee](https://hiero.org/tsc): elected member, under the Linux Foundation.
- [HIP-920](https://hips.hedera.com/hip/hip-920): authored Informational-track proposal for NFT music metadata that reached Active status.

## Live show

- [/live](https://itsbrandond.com/live): a live show on X. Explaining what's being built, reacting to the day's technology news, digging into things that don't add up, and taking questions from chat. Still being built together in public; open source, so anyone can share clips freely.
- Replays are on X at `x.com/i/broadcasts/<broadcast id>`.

## Media

- [HederaCon 2025's wallet refresh talk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FTXUdQ6dTf8): moderated panel.
- [Hashgraph Enthusiasts Show](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CpjLibi4jp4): created and hosted for three years, 146 episodes interviewing founders and engineers across the ecosystem.
